RvX-Rolled-Zerg.description: Random player rolling Zerg: 13 Overlord -> 16 Hatchery -> 18 Extractor -> 17 Spawning Pool -> 20 Overlord -> 2x Queen + 4 Zerglings (universal safe opening before opponent race adaptation)

RvX-Rolled-Terran.description: Random player rolling Terran: 14 Supply Depot (ramp wall) -> 16 Barracks -> 16 Refinery -> 19 Orbital Command + Reaper scout -> 20 Command Center (Natural) -> 21 Factory

RvX-Rolled-Protoss.description: Random player rolling Protoss: 14 Pylon (low-ground/ramp wall) -> 16 Gateway (Probe scout) -> 17 Assimilator -> 20 Nexus -> 20 Cybernetics Core -> 21 Assimilator -> 22 Pylon

ZvR-Anti-Random-Zerg.description: Zerg vs unknown Random opponent: 13 Overlord + 14 Drone scout -> 16 Hatchery -> 18 Extractor -> 17 Spawning Pool (holds 2nd Overlord & Bane Nest/Roach Warren choice until Drone scout identifies T/P/Z at ~1:05)

TvR-Anti-Random-Terran.description: Terran vs unknown Random opponent: 14 Supply Depot at main ramp -> 16 Barracks + 16 SCV scout -> 16 Refinery -> 19 Reaper + Orbital Command -> 20 Command Center on high/low ground after SCV confirms race

PvR-Anti-Random-Protoss.description: Protoss vs unknown Random opponent: 14 Pylon at natural/ramp wall -> 16 Gateway + immediate 16 Probe scout -> 17 Assimilator -> 20 Cybernetics Core before/after 20 Nexus depending on Zerg/Terran/Protoss identification
